body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within 3 units; requires loose debris or mundane trap material.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 Piercing Damage. Independently, the target's space becomes difficult terrain until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: An adjacent empty space also becomes difficult terrain.
On a hit, the target is Slowed 2 until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Contingency - Trap
rider.html: When an enemy voluntarily leaves either prepared space, you may move 1 unit and make that creature Exposed until your next turn.
